answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 35069 Country: India Title: REGARDING TRIMMING UGLY HAIRS Question: I do not cut my hairs but end of the hairs look ugly, not for fashion but making myself look proper can I trim my hairs? I will not do hair cutting and I cover hairs with head scarf. Think over it and reply according to Islam. Answer ID: 35069 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1847/1847/M=1432) If the hair of a woman do not grow at all, it may be allowable for her to trim a little length from the tip of the hair so that they grow to normal length. But, if there is no such an excuse, a woman should avoid trimming hair only for looking proper. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
